Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 153. Category: stance. Stances.

Prerequisites: dexterity 13+, 1 simple or martial
Weapon proficiency
A fighting style based around mixing weapons and ki
attacks.
+2 Static Bonus to attack rolls when using a Simple
or Martial Weapon to take the attack action
+1 Static Bonus to Weapon and Blast Techniques
If you do a melee weapon attack using a martial or
simple weapon that you are proficient with as your
action you can fire 2 ki blasts as your bonus action.
